info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Switching L2
info.description:
Layer 2 switching configuration from Cisco-IOS-XE-native model.

**Includes:** bridge-domain, ethernet, mac, mac-address-table, vtp, port-channel, otv, l2, vxlan

**Key Features:**
- Bridge domains
- Ethernet configuration
- MAC address table
- VLAN Trunking Protocol (VTP)
- Port channels
- Overlay Transport Virtualization (OTV)
- VXLAN

**Base Path:** `/data/Cisco-IOS-XE-native:native/`

**Related:** See 'Top-Level Containers' for VLAN and spanning-tree

**YANG Model:** [Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Switching L2.yang](https://github.com/YangModels/yang/blob/main/vendor/cisco/xe/17181/Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Switching L2.yang)

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Limit the depth of returned sub-tree data (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.2). Use 'unbounded' for full depth.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select specific fields to return (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.3). Example: fields=name;status

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Filter by config state: 'config' (config true only), 'nonconfig' (config false only), or 'all'.
